mode.description: The mode of the coding agent. Use analyze to gather information, write to generate a PR, or review to evaluate and publish a review for an existing PR when review mode is enabled for this job.

repository.description: The url of the repository to create a PR for

base_branch.description: Required for review mode; otherwise optional. The branch to clone for a normal run and use as its pull request base. Leave it blank unless explicitly prompted to set it. Do not use this for follow-up runs.

head_branch.description: Required when `followup` is true. The existing pull request's head branch. The harness checks out this branch before starting the agent so it can commit and push its additional work there.

pr_url.description: Required for review mode and whenever `followup` is true. The URL of the existing pull request to review or continue. For review runs, this URL is provided directly to the review agent as pull request context.

prompt.description: The prompt to give to the coding agent.  This should be a detailed prompt that describes the changes you want to make to the repository.  Commonmark Markdown formatting is encouraged to convey structure and semantic importance.

babysit.description: When true, requests babysitting behavior for this run. Enables the agent to track CI failures and user comments.  Useful for application code prs or complex changes

followup.description: When true, this run performs additional work on an existing pull request. You MUST always provide `pr_url` (the existing PR URL) and `head_branch` (that PR's head branch). The agent commits and pushes to the current branch; it does not create a branch or a new pull request.
